text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: new hire Priyanka Mehta starts Wed 09/09 but she's international and arriving from SEA. Need to coordinate I-9, visa docs verification, laptop shipment hold, and benefits timing. Who can cover on-site verification if passport is available?
Lena (Hiring): I'll be on site that morning and can meet at reception at 08:45. She said she may only have a stamped work visa + passport photocopy — is that OK for I-9? :flag-in: 
Sam (People Ops): For I-9, passport is fine. If she only has passport copy + visa stamp, we need the original passport. We can do remote inspection within 3 days with an authorized verifier, but for new hires arriving out of country we prefer same-day.
Arjun (IT): Laptop is currently scheduled to ship to the office; I'll mark "hold at reception" and reserve imaging slot 09:15-09:35. I'll label the MacBook "Priyanka M".
Marta (Security): BG check must be green before permanent badge. If BG is still pending, we can issue a temp badge for building access only. Need approval from People Ops to expedite badge photo.
onboard-bot: Background check link sent to priyanka.mehta@redwood.ai. Status: pending consent. Reminder in 8 hours.
Lena (Hiring): She says she'll arrive on a red-eye and might not make the 09:15 window. Can we offer late remote I-9 16:00 PT?
Sam (People Ops): Yes, offer remote verifier slot at 16:00. Remote rules: show original documents on camera and upload scans within 3 business days. Add note in HRIS "remote I-9 scheduled".
Arjun (IT): If she can't enroll MDM in person, IT can do dropbox enrollment with temporary credentials and require MFA setup within 24 hours. I'll include USB-C dongle in laptop sleeve.
Marta (Security): Reminder: per policy, permanent badge activation requires BG green + identity docs on file. Temp badge OK for orientation only.
Sam (People Ops): Action items: 1) Lena meet at reception 08:45 2) Arjun hold laptop + imaging 09:15 slot 3) Offer remote I-9 16:00 if passport not present 4) Marta expedite temp badge photo if needed 5) Send benefits enrollment email same day so she can elect coverage within 30 days.
Lena (Hiring): I'll ping candidate tonight to confirm passport arrival and remind about GoodHire link + W-4.
Arjun (IT): Noted. I'll also pre-create email/github accounts and set password reset to personal email.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll update the calendar invite and HRIS notes. Priyanka, welcome in advance! :tada:
